title: We Listen And We Don't Judge

youtube_title: The mall Santa crew has one rule in the break room: we listen and we don't judge 🎅
description:
It is the first day of the season at the mall, and the break room has one rule: you confess, nobody judges. Kenzie the elf, a very old snow globe and manager Denise go first. Then Walt, the mall Santa, has something to say.

lines.text: Welcome to the break room. First day of the season. You know the rule.
We listen and we don't judge.
I am the snow globe by the fountain. I have been in this mall since nineteen eighty seven. I have heard things.
Kenzie. You are new. You go first.
Okay. I am a head elf. And I have never seen snow.
Never?
I grew up in the desert. I thought snow was a rumor.
I am full of snow. Right now. Look at me.
That is glitter. And there is a little shrimp in there.
That is Gerald. He fell in during a seafood festival in two thousand nine. We do not talk about Gerald.
We listen and we don't judge. Snow globe. Your turn.
Every time a child shakes me, I scream a little. Inside. Very politely.
Denise. What about you?
I run this whole holiday village. And I have no idea how the train works.
The little train? The one kids ride around the tree?
It just goes. For twelve years. Nobody has ever seen it stop. I am scared of it.
It stopped once. In nineteen ninety four. A man in a reindeer sweater got off and was never seen again.
We listen. And we don't judge. Walt. Last one.
Well. I don't know how to say this.
It is okay. You can tell us anything.
I do not like cookies.
Oh no.
Walt, you are a mall Santa. Cookies are the whole job.
I eat them anyway. Every one. To be polite. It has been a very long time.
How long have you been a mall Santa?
At this mall? Since it opened.
That is not a joke. He was here before me. He was here before the fountain.
I have watched him through my glass for thirty nine years. He has not gotten one day older.
Walt. Who are you?
I am the real one. I like to hear what the kids want in person. The letters have a lot of spelling.
You are the real Santa. And you hate cookies.
We listen. And we don't judge.
Then how does the train work?
Two of my reindeer. Under the tree skirt. They walk in a circle. They like it.
That explains the hay. I have been asking about the hay for twelve years.
Wait. Can I see snow? Real snow? At the North Pole?
Head elf, you said? Then you work for me now. Bring a coat.
Best first day ever.
Hold on. Who is going to be Santa at the mall tomorrow?
The man from the train. He has been riding it since nineteen ninety four. He is ready.
Can I come too? Gerald has always wanted to see the ocean. Any ocean.
Everybody comes. Last thing. Kenzie, what do you want for Christmas?
A pony.
We listen. And we don't judge. But no.
I listen. And I judge. A little.
